'''Hunde Decan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Decan once owned a [[Corellian Fried Ice Cream Fryer]], but lost the device. Sometime after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] found the fryer, but it was broken. The spacer then decided to meet with Decan to ask if he could assist with fixing the fryer or making a new one. Decan gave the spacer a fryer basket that belonged to the fryer and told the spacer to speak to [[Amyva Va'new]], an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who lived on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

==Behind the scenes==
Hunde Decan was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FonatF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Hunde Decan was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Portable Deep Fryer|"Portable Deep Fryer" collection]] introduced with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|Chapter 9]],"<ref>{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67692&month=042008|text=Weekly Picks – 4/3/08 - 04/03/2008}}</ref> published on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>

In the game, Hunde Decan could be found out in the wilderness of Lok. He was part of the quest line ''"Find out more about the Cooker"'' (and the interconnected [[:w:c:swg:Collection|Collection]] [[:w:c:swg:CollectionPortable Deep Fryer|Portable Deep Fryer]]) that started when the player inspected a [[:w:c:swg:Broken Fryer|broken ice cream fryer]]. The player then had to talk to several NPCs on different planets to gather more information about the fryer. When finished with the quest, the player was rewarded with a schematic for a Corellian Fried Ice Cream Fryer.
